yt_title: Crows Remember Human Faces for Years #Shorts
desc: Studies show crows can recognise individual human faces and even warn other crows about people who threatened them. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Be nice to crows. They remember. 🐦‍⬛ Would you trust one? Tell us below.

lines.text: Be careful how you treat a crow.
Researchers wore a scary mask while catching crows.
Years later, crows still scolded anyone wearing that same mask.
Even crows that were never caught joined in, because the others taught them.
So yes, crows really do hold a grudge.
